displayName: Garlic + Stone Fruit (peach borer + aphid suppression)
benefit: Garlic planted in a 24 inch ring around stone-fruit trunks repels peach tree borer and reduces aphid colonization on lower scaffolds. Sulfur compounds in garlic foliage disrupt host-finding by adult clearwing moths.

members.title: Garlic ring at fruit-tree base
members.body: Plant hardneck garlic cloves in fall in a 24 inch ring around each tree, 6 inches between cloves. Leave in place each year.
